messages.subject: Highlight specific line in stat_contour
parts:
Dear all,

is it possible to highlight a specific line in a contour plot?
I can draw a single bold line:

library(reshape2)
volcano3d <- melt(volcano)
names(volcano3d) <- c("x", "y", "z")
v <- ggplot(volcano3d, aes(x, y, z = z)) + stat_contour()
v + stat_contour(bins=1, size=2)

But is it possible to highlight, e.g., exactly the 100-m-line?

Thanks,
Felix
